question: Which supreme power stands above the śiva principle and what is her role?
premises: Above the śiva principle is the supreme power.
She is established as the agent of all causes.
inference: Samanā is the supreme power above the śiva principle and functions as the active agent behind all causal principles.
plain_english: Above the śiva principle stands the supreme power called Samanā. She is established as the agent of all causes.
